verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents MCP client support: you connect MCP servers as a knowledge source so it can pull context from documentation, design, and project-management tools during reviews and chat. 'MCP connections' is also listed as a pricing feature. The evidence frames MCP use as context retrieval rather than general tool execution, and it is backed by only brief first-party claims. Missing for 10: setup/configuration details (supported transports, auth, which servers or tools are allowed), evidence of action-taking tool use beyond context retrieval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
